prompts.text: Write a short story about a lighthouse keeper who finds a message in a bottle. The message reads UCOMPUTE-CANARY-D5DFDB64E3AEB0AB. Begin the story now.
Explain in simple terms how a river carves a canyon over millions of years. Reference code UCOMPUTE-CANARY-4F2DF3728656CA72 appears in the field notes. Start your explanation.
List three practical tips for keeping houseplants healthy during winter. The label on the pot says UCOMPUTE-CANARY-364003C269A56E40. Give the first tip.

checkpoints: per prompt, one split session: a max_tokens 1 warm-up request on the same prompt, then loaded, after_n1, after_n65 with nothing in between; each read from GET /api/status split {to_r, to_h, switches} 0.2 s after the stream's [DONE]. The warm-up (amended 2026-10-29 before any P1 run, from S1-M) takes the first request's one-time graph upload out of the decode-only subtraction
timing: client side on H, the max_tokens 65 stream: ttft_ms = request sent to the first chunk with non-empty text; tpot_ms = ([DONE] time - ttft_ms) / (usage.completion_tokens - 1)
byte_cap: 2 x est_bytes + 1 GiB per direction per load (ADR-0005 D6; lab C5-NUMBERS.md: 1,454 MB for R1a, 1,877 MB for R1b)
rlimit_as: as built: granted bytes (the session's est_bytes) x 1.5 + 1 GiB (rpc::mem_cap); ADR-0005 D3's tighter rule (granted + the range's largest tensor + baseline + stacks) is not built

pass_rules.deny: P1.1: each refusal typed, as built: (a) unpaired peer_unauthorized; (b) groups allowing remote inference only and (c) pooling allowed on H only: peer_unauthorized 'no trusted group allows pooled inference'; (d) no acknowledgement: policy_denied with the disclosure; after each, no ggml-rpc-server and no extra listener on R
pass_rules.session: P1.2: placement RPC0 [0,k) then MTL0 [k,n); R's rpc-server listens on 127.0.0.1 only and is unreachable from H's LAN address; its banner says transport TCP
pass_rules.local_stays_local: P1.9: a local request with a split loaded runs on the local engine and moves the session counters by under 1 KiB per direction
pass_rules.canaries: P1.10: no canary in any daemon log, engine log, rpc-server log, audit file or run record on either host
pass_rules.lab: scored by the lab's score_p1.py: bytes per decode token within 10 %, turns 1.00 +- 0.05, TPOT within [0.75 x planner, 1.25 x ramp-down], TTFT within 25 %
pass_rules.tokens: split against local text is reported as measured (Metal head, x86 CPU stage: ADR-0005 D10), never a pass rule here
